description: This Java class defines an immutable data transfer object (DTO) named ClientCollateralManagementData for managing client collateral information within the collateral management module of the Fineract platform. It encapsulates details such as name, quantity, total value, total collateral, associated client ID, related loan transactions, and an internal identifier.

classes.name: ClientCollateralManagementData
classes.description: An immutable data class representing collateral data associated with a client, including identifiers, financial figures, and related transactions.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: A static factory method for creating instances of ClientCollateralManagementData by providing all required attributes.
